name: paradigm
description: Paradigm: an AI-first, node-based workflow whiteboard

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @paradigm/server & npm run dev --workspace @paradigm/web
scripts.start: npm run build --workspace @paradigm/web && npm run start --workspace @paradigm/server
scripts.views: python3 scripts/dc-to-jsx.py design/SignIn.dc.html SignInView apps/web/src/views/SignInView.tsx && python3 scripts/dc-to-jsx.py design/Workspace.dc.html WorkspaceView apps/web/src/views/WorkspaceView.tsx && python3 scripts/dc-to-jsx.py design/Main.dc.html BoardView apps/web/src/views/BoardView.tsx
